title: Facade
prompt: Onboarding must create user, wallet, and welcome email by calling three services in order. Callers duplicate the sequence. Fix?

choices.label: Add a facade operation that orchestrates the sequence once
choices.consequence: Callers should not wire the subsystem ballet.

choices.label: Leave the duplication
choices.consequence: Drift and partial failure stories multiply.

choices.label: Adapter each service to a random new interface without one entrypoint
Only document the steps in a wiki
choices.consequence: Docs do not enforce the path.
